changelog.1.2.4.0: Hunts for a monster that only invaded the quest — a Guardian Rathalos in an Arkveld quest, for example — are now hidden automatically, exactly like pressing Ignore.
changelog.1.2.4.1: Settings → Data → “Only quest objectives” turns it on or off. Older hunts are re-read from your export files, so the filter covers past quests too.
changelog.1.2.4.2: Ignores you made yourself are always kept. Turning the filter off restores only the hunts it hid. No mod update needed.
changelog.1.2.4.3: Hunts → All hunts now has Delete as well as Ignore: Delete removes a hunt from every stat and from the list for good (a re-import won't bring it back), and “Show deleted” lets you restore one.
changelog.1.2.4.title: Only quest objectives
changelog.1.2.5.0: The “What's new” note now stays closed after you close it. It used to come back on every launch because the desktop app picked a new local port each time, which reset the browser storage that remembered it.
changelog.1.2.5.1: The app now keeps a stable local port, so your last tab, hunter scope, filters and party size are remembered across launches too.
changelog.1.2.5.title: Fixes
changelog.1.2.6.0: Each hunter’s rank is now shown next to their name in a hunt’s party cards and in the Hunters tooltip — read from the HunterPie companion’s party export.
changelog.1.2.6.1: Party HP curves are now keyed by the game’s network member index, so a hunter’s near-death curve can no longer be assigned to another player.
changelog.1.2.6.2: A companion restarted mid-hunt is now merged back into the same hunt instead of creating a duplicate with no HP.
changelog.1.2.6.3: Bundles HuntDumper 0.12.7. If the mod pill asks you to reinstall, update the REFramework mod to match.
changelog.1.2.6.title: Hunter rank & HP fixes
changelog.1.3.0.0: The dashboard now speaks Japanese. Switch the language in Settings → Display; it defaults to your browser's language and the choice is remembered.
changelog.1.3.0.1: Monster and skill names come from the game's own Japanese text, so the app uses the same words as the quest results screen. Quest award names are still English until native review lands.
changelog.1.3.0.2: Numbers, dates and durations follow the selected language, and charts/tables re-render on the fly when you switch.
changelog.1.3.0.title: Japanese UI
